day_shape: 96 items: CENTCOM announces overnight airstrikes on Iran with regime channels reporting hits on residences in Qeshm, Farashband and Shadegan; State Dept designates two IRGC-linked Hormuz insurance entities; US-Saudi joint strikes hit Iraqi PMF; oil at $93.

threads.label: CENTCOM strikes on southern Iran
threads.summary: CENTCOM said US forces began strikes against Iran at 8pm ET Wednesday as a response to Iranian attacks on US bases in the Middle East. Defa Press and IRIB claimed hits on residential areas in Qeshm, a sports hall in Farashband, and areas around Abadan and Shadegan, alleging civilian casualties including a two-year-old.

threads.label: Strait of Hormuz shipping standoff
threads.summary: The US State Department designated the Persian Gulf Marine Insurance Company and Hormuz Safe Marine Services Authority for IRGC-backed coercive schemes, with Treasury adding sanctions on 10 entities and 8 tankers; CENTCOM said it has redirected 20 vessels, disabled 2 and boarded 2. A QatarEnergy LNG tanker exited Hormuz overnight, the first since July 11, while Iran said it stopped three commercial vessels.

threads.label: US-Saudi strikes on Iraqi militias
threads.summary: Joint US-Saudi airstrikes targeted Popular Mobilization Forces facilities across Iraq following an IRGC missile strike on a US base in Jordan. Iraq's National Security Council and PM Ali al-Zaidi held an emergency meeting and condemned the strikes.

threads.label: Regional widening: Egypt, Yemen, Saudi
threads.summary: The Jerusalem Post cited a New York Times report attributing a US tanker explosion at Egypt's Damietta port to an Iranian drone attack, following the Houthi-declared naval blockade on Saudi Arabia. Saudi Arabia is seeking to build an international coalition to protect Red Sea shipping, while the Houthis consider imposing transit fees.

threads.label: Netanyahu-Trump talks and Israeli posture
threads.summary: Netanyahu denied pushing Trump to escalate the Iran war after their Tuesday meeting on diplomacy, Hormuz and possible further action; a senior Israeli official said Israel backs intensified economic pressure while preserving military threat. IDF Chief Zamir told troops in southern Lebanon the campaign is not over, and Israel said its nuclear program assessment is that Iran retains centrifuges at Pickaxe Mountain.

threads.label: Khamenei and IRGC vengeance messaging
threads.summary: Khamenei's office posted messages calling for perpetrators of the Minab and Lamer strikes to face judicial prosecution and pledging vengeance for martyred children. The IRGC issued Announcement No. 54 warning countries aiding US forces and claimed two oil tankers had been stopped, while alleging missiles were fired at Iran from Kuwaiti territory.

threads.label: Iran-linked plots abroad and espionage
threads.summary: A Norwegian teenager was convicted in the UK of conspiracy to commit murder after being recruited by an Iranian government-linked Swedish organized crime group. An IDF reservist in a classified unit was indicted in Israel for spying for Iran.
